華潤集團於中國的城市燃氣分銷旗艦
華潤燃氣控股有限公司（「華潤燃氣」）主要由中國最大的國有企業集團之一的華潤（集團）有限公司擁有。作為中國領先的燃氣
公用事業集團，華潤燃氣主要從事下游城市燃氣分銷業務，包括管道天然氣分銷及天然氣加氣站業務及燃氣器具銷售。華潤燃
氣的業務策略性地分佈於全國各地，主要位於經濟較發達和人口密集的地區以及天然氣儲量豐富的地區。

憑藉良好的行業基礎及本集團的執行能力，華潤燃氣於二零二零年繼續通過內涵式增長及收購實現快速擴張。於二零二零年
末，華潤燃氣的城市燃氣項目總共達257個，分佈於中國22個省份，其中包括14個省會城巿及3個直轄市，年燃氣總銷量達約
290億立方米及客戶數達4,184萬戶。

能源結構優化和環境污染治理將推動中國天然氣消費持續增長。中國政府近年來採取多項措施提倡對污染較少的能源資源的發
展及使用。同煤炭及原油等傳統能源資源相比，天然氣產業符合國家創新、協調、綠色、開放、共享的核心發展理念，國家在
「十四·五」規劃和2035年遠景目標綱要草案中再次強調推動綠色低碳發展，加強生態文明建設，天然氣的推廣及應用對保護生
態環境、促進綠色轉型具有重要作用。

中國仍是全球天然氣發展最重要區域，中國天然氣市場仍處於重要發展期，華潤燃氣將會充分利用有利經營環境，透過內涵及
外延式增長持續擴張、在追求卓越表現的同時努力提升其經營效率、提供安全可靠的清潔能源供應並向客戶提供體貼、周到及
高效的服務，向股東提供不斷增長且可持續的業績表現，為僱員創造廣泛且專業的個人發展機會，為中國及世界的環境保護及
改善做出貢獻，成為中國燃氣行業最受尊敬的領導者。


THE PRC CITY GAS DISTRIBUTION FLAGSHIP OF CHINA RESOURCES GROUP
China Resources Gas Group Limited (“CR Gas”), substantially owned by China Resources (Holdings) Company
Limited, one of the largest state-owned conglomerates in China, is a leading gas utilities group in China, which is
principally engaged in downstream city gas distribution business including piped natural gas distribution, natural gas
filling stations operation and sales of gas appliances. Its operations are strategically located in areas of China, which
are economically more developed and densely populated and areas with rich reserves of natural gas.

Leveraging on the excellent industry fundamentals and the Group’s execution competency, CR Gas continues to expand
rapidly in 2020 via organic and acquisition growths. At the end of 2020, CR Gas’s portfolio consisted of 257 city gas
projects in 22 provinces of China including 14 provincial capitals and 3 direct administrative municipalities with an annual
gross gas sales volume of some 29.0 billion cubic meters and 41.84 million customers.

The optimization of energy structure and environmental pollution control will promote the sustainable growth of natural gas
consumption in China. The PRC government has, in recent years, taken various measures to promote the development and
utilization of less polluting energy sources. The natural gas industry is in sync with the core development idea of innovation,
harmony, green, open and sharing as compared with conventional energy resources such as coal and crude oil. In “The
14th Five-Year Plan” and the draft of “Long-Range Objectives through the Year 2035”, the state once again emphasized
that the promotion of green and low-carbon development, the enhancement of the construction of ecological civilization
and the promotion and application of natural gas played an important role in protecting the ecological environment and
promoting the transition to green development.

The natural gas market in China is still in the important development period, as China remains the most important region
in the global rise of natural gas development. CR Gas is well placed to take advantage of such a favorable operating
environment and to become the most respectable leader in the PRC’s gas industry by continuously expanding through
organic and external growths; diligently enhancing its operational efficiency in pursue of excellence; delivering a safe
and reliable supply of clean energy as well as the caring, competent and efficient service to our customers; offering
growing and sustainable performance to shareholders; creating extensive professional and personal development
opportunities to employees; and contributing to the protection and improvement of the Chinese and global environment.

董事會成員多元化政策              BOARD DIVERSITY POLICY
本公司於二零一三年八月二十三日採納董      The Company adopted a board diversity policy (the “Policy”) on 23rd
事會成員多元化政策（「政策」）。此政策之    August, 2013. A summary of this Policy, together with the measurable
概要連同為執行此政策而制定之可計量目      objectives set for implementing this Policy, and the progress made
標及達標進度於下文披露。            towards achieving those objectives are disclosed as below.


政策概要                    Summary of the Policy

本公司視董事會層面的多元化為維持競爭      The Company sees diversity at Board level as an essential element in
優勢的重要元素。一個真正多元化的董事      maintaining a competitive advantage. A truly diverse Board will include
會將包括具備不同技能、地區及行業經       and make good use of differences in the skills, regional and industry
驗、背景、性別及其他特質的董事會成       experience, background, gender and other qualities of the members
員，並可加以利用。該等差異將於釐定董      of the Board. These differences will be considered in determining
事會的最適合組成時予以考慮，並於可能      the optimum composition of the Board and when possible should be
情況下保持適當平衡。董事會所有委任均      balanced appropriately. All Board appointments are made on merit, in
按董事會整體有效運作所需要的技能及經      the content of the skills and experience the Board as a whole requires
驗水平作出。                  to be effective.

     提名政策                                       Nomination Policy

     提名政策旨在確保本公司的董事會董事                          Nomination policy aims to ensure that the board of directors of the
     （「董事會」）在技能、經驗、知識及多元化                       Company (the “Board”) has a balance of skills, experience, knowledge
     觀點方面取得平衡，切合本公司的業務要                         and diversity of perspectives appropriate to the requirements of the

     長期獎勵計劃                                     LONG TERM AWARD SCHEME
     於二零零八年十二月一日，本公司採納一                         On 1st December, 2008, the Company adopted a share repurchased
     項股份購回現金獎勵計劃（「獎勵計劃」），                       cash award scheme (the “Incentive Award Scheme”), pursuant to
     據此，本集團或投資公司的經甄選僱員皆                         which selected employees of the Group or investee companies (being
     有權根據計劃規則參加獎勵計劃。投資公                         any company in which the Company directly or indirectly owns 5%
     司乃指任何一家由本公司直接或間接擁有                         or more attributable equity interests (the “Investee Company”), and
     5%或以上歸屬權益的公司（「投資公司」），                      in calculating the percentage interest so attributed, the percentage
     就計算歸屬權益百分比而言，在投資公司                         interest held in the Investee Company shall be multiplied by the
     所持有權益的百分比須乘以本集團透過其                         percentage interest in each level of entity through which such interest
     他公司持有該權益的該等中間公司的百分                         is held by the Group), are entitled to participate in the Incentive Award
     比。                                         Scheme pursuant to the scheme rules.


     獎勵計劃旨在嘉許若干僱員的貢獻及鼓勵                         The purpose of the Incentive Award Scheme is to recognise and
     彼等作出貢獻，並提供獎勵及協助本集團                         motivate the contribution of certain employees and to provide
     及投資公司挽留其現有僱員及延聘更多僱                         incentives and to enable the Group and the Investee Company in
     員，並就達到本公司的長期商業目標向彼                         retaining their existing employees and recruiting additional employees
     等提供直接經濟利益。除非被董事會提前                         and to provide them with a direct economic interest in attaining
     終止，獎勵計劃自採納日期起十年內有                          the long-term business objectives of the Company. Unless early
     效。根據獎勵計劃授出獎勵股份及於其整                         termination by the Board, the Incentive Award Scheme shall be valid
     個有效期內授予經甄選僱員獎勵股份的總                         and effective for a term of 10 years commencing on the adoption
     數上限分別以本公司不時已發行股本的5%                        date. The maximum aggregate numbers of award shares which can
     及0.5%為限。                                   be awarded under the Incentive Award Scheme and to a selected
                                                employee throughout its duration are limited to 5% and 0.5% of the
                                                issued share capital of the Company from time to time respectively.

                更多指引。該等修訂說明，就                                  clarify that for an integrated set of activities and assets
                被視為業務之一系列綜合活動及                                 to be considered a business, it must include, at a
                資產而言，其須包括最少一項對                                 minimum, an input and a substantive process that together
                共同創造產出能力有顯著貢獻之                                 significantly contribute to the ability to create output. A
                投入及實質程序。業務可以不包                                 business can exist without including all of the inputs and
                括創造產出所需之所有投入及過                                 processes needed to create outputs. The amendments
                程而存在。該等修訂取消對市場                                 remove the assessment of whether market participants
                參與者是否有能力收購業務並繼                                 are capable of acquiring the business and continue to
                續創造產出之評估。相反，重點                                 produce outputs. Instead, the focus is on whether acquired
                在於獲得之投入及實質性過程是                                 inputs and acquired substantive processes together
                否共同對創造產出能力有顯著貢                                 significantly contribute to the ability to create outputs. The
                獻。該等修訂還縮窄產出之定                                  amendments have also narrowed the definition of outputs
                義，重點關注向客戶提供之貨品                                 to focus on goods or services provided to customers,
                或服務、投資收入或源自普通活                                 investment income or other income from ordinary activities.
                動之其他收入。此外，修訂提供                                 Furthermore, the amendments provide guidance to

                具重要性，並引入可選之公平值                                 introduce an optional fair value concentration test to permit
                集中測試，以便簡化評估所獲得                                 a simplified assessment of whether an acquired set of

  租賃 － 估計增量借貸利率                        Leases – Estimating the incremental borrowing rate

   本集團無法輕易釐定租賃內所隱含的                    The Group cannot readily determine the interest rate implicit in a
   利率，因此，使用增量借貸利率（「增                   lease, and therefore, it uses an incremental borrowing rate (“IBR”)
   量借貸利率」）計量租賃負債。增量借                   to measure lease liabilities. The IBR is the rate of interest that
   貸利率為本集團於類似經濟環境中為                    the Group would have to pay to borrow over a similar term, and
   取得與使用權資產價值相近之資產，                    with a similar security, the funds necessary to obtain an asset
   而以類似抵押品與類似期間借入所需                    of a similar value to the right-of-use asset in a similar economic
   資金應支付之利率。因此，增量借貸                    environment. The IBR therefore reflects what the Group “would
   利率反映了本集團「應支付」的利率，                   have to pay”, which requires estimation when no observable
   當無可觀察的利率時（如就並無訂立                    rates are available (such as for subsidiaries that do not enter
   融資交易之附屬公司而言）或當須對                    into financing transactions) or when it needs to be adjusted to
   利率進行調整以反映租賃之條款及條                    reflect the terms and conditions of the lease (for example, when
   件時（如當租賃並非以附屬公司之功                    leases are not in the subsidiary’s functional currency). The Group
   能貨幣訂立時），則須作出利率估計。                   estimates the IBR using observable inputs (such as market
   當可觀察輸入數據可用時，本集團使                    interest rates) when available and is required to make certain
   用 可 觀 察 輸 入 數 據（ 如 市 場 利 率 ）估       entity-specific estimates (such as the subsidiary’s stand-alone

  現金產生單位的可收回金額乃按使用                  The recoverable amounts of the CGUs are determined based on
  價值計算方法釐定。計算使用價值時                  value-in-use calculations. The key assumptions for the value-in-
  的主要假設與折現率、增長率及售價                  use calculations are those regarding the discount rates, growth
  與直接成本的預期變動有關。管理層                  rates and expected changes to selling prices and direct costs.
  乃採用可反映有關貨幣時值及現金產                  Management estimates discount rates using pre-tax rates that
  生單位持有的風險的現行市場評估的                  reflect current market assessments of the time value of money
  稅前比率估計貼現率。增長率按業內                  and the risks specific to the CGUs. The growth rates are based
  增長預測計算。售價及直接成本的變                  on industry growth forecasts. Changes in selling prices and
  動則按過往慣例及預期市場未來變化                  direct costs are based on past practices and expectations of
  而釐定。                              future changes in the market.

        團提名的宜賓華潤的所有高級管                  Accordingly, the Group takes the control over all significant

        本集團以經常性基準按公平值計                  Fair value of the Group’s financial assets that are measured
        量的金融資產的公平值（續）                   at fair value on a recurring basis (Continued)

        公平值計量根據公平值計量的輸                  Fair value measurements are categorised into Level 1, 2, or
        入數據可觀察程度及公平值計量                  3 based on the degree to which the inputs to the fair value
        的輸入數據對其整體的重要性分                  measurements are observable and the significance of the
        類為第一級、第二級或第三級，                  inputs to the fair value measurement in its entirety, which
        詳情如下：                           are described as follows:


        (i)     第一級輸入數據是實體於             (i)     Level 1 inputs are quoted prices (unadjusted) in active
                計量日期可以取得的相同                     markets for identical assets or liabilities that the entity
                資產或負債於活躍市場之                     can access at the measurement date;
                報價（未經調整）；


        (ii)    第二級輸入數據是就資產             (ii)    Level 2 inputs are inputs, other than quoted prices
                或負債直接或間接地可觀                     included within Level 1, that are observable for the
